what: Three bundles of vertical dash columns stand on a black canvas (14 lines per bundle, 8 lines under 640 width) — 21 dashes each (thickness 2.5~3.5px, width scales 375→1440) · 10px gap (phone 16·8). The side bundles stand only in the lower 60% of the canvas, and the closer a line is to the bundle’s center, the lower it sits (half a dash per step), carving a V. The empty cells above are drawn from the bottom up, one cell at a time in .15s (2.5s per bundle), so the columns grow, rest 1s, then repeat. The center bundle hangs from the top and sags into a U (−.8~3.3 cells per line). Each dash darkens top to bottom from .15 → 1, and every .4s 5% of the visible dashes turn blue for .8s at their own darkness.

options.bars: Lines per group, default 14 (8 under 640 width)
options.draw: Seconds to draw the whole empty cell, default 2.5
options.blue: Share that lights up blue, default .05
options.--fx-dash: Dash color (CSS variable), default --kf-dim — the original is a #404040 tone that blends into the background (one variant uses --kf-dim 55% + background)
options.--fx-blue: Blinking blue (CSS variable), default --kf-accent — the original is a muted #3a6a99 tone

note: The original (builder hub initHeroBars) draws all pillars, then lifts them from the center outward and flows clones downward to join them. This part omits that lift and clone flow and keeps only the drawing, V/U layout and blue blinking at the same values. Dash --kf-dim, blue --kf-accent.

from.where: service.html hero (original builder-hub [data-bars-canvas] — 3 groups × 14 · dash 21/10 · hidden top 40% · draw 2.5s · blue 5%)
